translation: The blood of the head (頭血) treats night-blindness (雀盲). The droppings of the male sparrow (雄雀矢) treat eye-pain, opening carbuncles and furuncles (決癰癤), women's dai xia (帶下), difficulty of urination (溺不利), and removing abdominal masses and hernias (疝瘕). It is good to take them in the fifth month.
